behavior: A machine missing make and Poetry, where both installs succeed, reaches the hand-off: make setup-ansible runs and the script exits 0.
A prerequisite that fails to install still blocks the hand-off, and the message counts only the unresolved ones.
--check on a host where sudo requires a password reports that root is unavailable and exits 1, without attempting an install.
No path in the script can block on a password prompt: as_root never invokes sudo without -n, and on a host that really is root the command runs directly.
verification: poetry run pytest tests/test_bootstrap_controller_script.py -q -k "as_root_never_invokes_sudo_without_dash_n or install_path_runs_as_root_without_sudo"

behavior: apt-get update runs without -qq, so a lock/permission failure is visible.
